routinesDetail.title: Dead-Code Gardener
remainingGaps: Findings are candidates: deletion still requires usage and external-contract evidence a static scan cannot see (docs, workflows, supported consumers).

routinesDetail.title: Architecture and Abstraction Doctor
remainingGaps: Cycles and duplication are structural signals only; abstraction quality and ownership remain judgment work.

routinesDetail.title: Error, Diagnostics, and Incident Learner
remainingGaps: Incident learning (post-incident reproduction and diagnostics review) has no detector; only swallowed exceptions and sensor coverage failures are observed.

routinesDetail.title: Test Portfolio Gardener
remainingGaps: Weak assertions and redundant coverage are not measured; only shadowed tests, unregistered markers and empty modules are.

routinesDetail.title: Flake and Isolation Hunter
remainingGaps: Flake history depends on a driver-supplied test-history input; without it the sensor is not evaluated, never healthy.

routinesDetail.title: CLI and Runtime Contract Steward
remainingGaps: Runtime contract checks beyond the static command surface (exit codes, output formats) are not observed.

routinesDetail.title: Mutation, Authorization, and Abuse-Boundary Examiner
remainingGaps: Authorization behaviour is checked statically; abuse paths needing runtime exercise remain manual.

routinesDetail.title: Schema Evolution Steward
remainingGaps: Schema compatibility across versions (breaking-change detection) is not observed; only validity and mirror parity are.

routinesDetail.title: Evidence and Trust Reconciler
remainingGaps: Hooks 1922, 1445 and 2063 remain unknown/not-evaluated until fresh independent verification.
Trust calibration findings are report-only until the Star Bar is applied in the sensor; calibration needs founder approval.

routinesDetail.title: Timeline Causality Keeper
remainingGaps: Out-of-order events are detected; their correction is a curated, human-gated timeline decision (see steward-timeline-order-1699).

routinesDetail.title: Registry Structure and Installability Examiner
remainingGaps: Installability against live upstream repositories is not probed (no network).

routinesDetail.title: Artifact, Branch, and Repository Hygiene Sentinel
remainingGaps: Stale remote branches and large-artifact growth are not observed.

routinesDetail.title: CI Architecture and Efficiency Steward
remainingGaps: CI health depends on a driver-supplied run history; without it ci-health is not evaluated, never healthy.
CI cost and cache efficiency are not measured.

routinesDetail.title: Release and Supply-Chain Examiner
remainingGaps: Advisories depend on a driver-supplied pip-audit run; without it dependency-advisory is not evaluated.
Release artifact provenance (wheel contents, signatures) is not observed.

routinesDetail.title: Frontend Quality and Resilience Steward
remainingGaps: Accessibility and visual correctness are not observed: the render input records load, script-error and overflow facts only, so no accessibility or visual assurance is claimed; frontend fixes are human-gated by CLAUDE.md.
The browser render needs a driver (Chromium via scripts/steward_collect_browser_render.js); without a fresh input the detector is not evaluated, never healthy.
Browser findings come from a local static server with external requests aborted, so they may differ from the deployed site.

routinesDetail.title: Browser, Privacy, and External Trust Auditor
remainingGaps: Third-party script and privacy-policy review remain manual; sinks are lexical findings.

routinesDetail.title: Knowledge, Nomenclature, and Agent-Surface Editor
remainingGaps: Banned-vocabulary and nomenclature checks run in their own CI gates, not as Steward detectors.

routinesDetail.title: GitHub Issue Hygiene
remainingGaps: Human-authored issues outside the upstream and gh-aw bot families are not reconciled; hygiene never closes or classifies them.
Bot families other than gh-aw are reported as untracked; their reports are not dispositioned.
Pull-request linking uses merged-pull-request evidence from the census only; a referenced or open pull request is never closure proof.
Closure is limited to rules A1 to A5 as enabled in POLICY; any item outside them is batch review or a founder question.
